# People Atlas 0.13.0 — Alpha

> [!WARNING]
> People Atlas 0.13.0 is alpha software. Its fundamental behavior may change in
> future releases.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **People Atlas requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer.
> Obsidian 1.12.x and older are not supported.**

This release improves finding people, reviewing data problems, understanding
relationships and following up, while keeping notes and settings local.

## Changes

- **Wider people discovery:** search aliases, role, organization, email and phone.
  Choose the current view or all permitted people independently of the graph's
  display limit. In a Base, all means only the entries admitted by that Base.
- **Stable view restoration:** restore the network center by person ID, with
  optional mode and population state. Selecting a person from the wider list
  shows their details without implicitly changing the network center.
- **Complete diagnostics and reviewed repair:** filter the full diagnostic list,
  preview adopting an existing note, or repair missing and duplicate person IDs
  at the exact reviewed path. Duplicate people are never silently merged.
- **Relationship context:** record end dates and desired contact intervals,
  inspect historical networks, compare shortest paths and common contacts, and
  use an explicit-role family layout. New Bases examples cover family, work and
  follow-up views.
- **Follow-up and attention:** filter completed and dismissed history, reopen a
  follow-up, or postpone it by one week after reviewing the resulting date.
  Local birthday and observed-contact cadence suggestions open the regular
  contact editor; saving remains explicit.
- **Safety and usability fixes:** reject stale relationship edits, search people
  in the contact picker, retain Base admission and privacy boundaries, reuse
  contact reference indexes, and fully paint the canvas background at fractional
  pane sizes and display scales.

## Upgrade and recovery

Settings recovery is optional and supports valid **schema 7 settings only**.
Review the proposed changes and confirm a valid People root before saving.
Recovery retains the exact original plugin-data text in a local backup that
survives later settings saves. Malformed or unsupported settings remain read-only.

This is settings recovery, not a note or dossier migration. Older folder layouts
are not automatically converted, and opening or previewing a repair writes
nothing. Existing-note adoption and ID repair each require an explicit reviewed
save.

## Assets and verification boundary

Install or update using the attached `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css`.
The release workflow validates and attests these three files. Automated tests
cover synthetic browser and controlled-host behavior; native Obsidian, mobile
and real-vault installation are separate acceptance steps. Community Plugins
directory submission remains separate from this GitHub prerelease.
